
# AP Structural provenance

AP Structural Display Black `0.1.0-candidate.1` is a modified version of
Urbanist Black. The source is `kit/source/Urbanist-Black.ttf` at SHA-256
`ea0fc2180daff145250764c96c4a297671bc58c8a87d2ead300e8a2d02ddfd9b`.

The candidate preserves the source glyph order and character map, scales glyph
outlines and horizontal metrics to 90 percent width, removes the source hint
program after outline reconstruction, and writes AP Structural family metadata.
The source lineage commit is `3fce36bee9af1ace23ea1ab70c45d46b9a117975`.

Urbanist and this modified font are distributed under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1 in `OFL.txt`. The upstream license declares no Reserved Font Name.
The Urbanist Project Authors are credited only as the upstream font authors.
No endorsement is implied.

Status is `candidate`. Use is limited to the approved localhost preview until
Ani explicitly promotes this exact packet to `web-ready`. Urbanist Black
remains the production display font.
